name: Station charger current-limit interface
aliases: substations Station battery and charger distribution
summary: Represents the selected charger output-current limiting function and its supervisory indication.
description: Represents the selected charger output-current limiting function and its supervisory indication. A station battery system supplies protection, control and other assigned DC loads through a documented charger and distribution arrangement. Charger output, battery contribution and load distribution are related but separately monitored paths.

In a substation control building, the battery can support breaker trip circuits while the charger AC supply is unavailable. Supervision must identify whether the charger, battery or a downstream feeder is affected. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Charger output current” at the input and “Current-limit state” at the output. A current limit differs from an output fault.
